name: tattoo
description: A self-hosted, versioned content desk for multi-platform publishing.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @tattoo/contracts" "npm run dev -w @tattoo/server" "npm run dev -w @tattoo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tattoo/contracts && npm run build -w @tattoo/server && npm run build -w @tattoo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tattoo/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests docs scripts *.json *.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests docs scripts *.json *.yml
